run_simulation_with_dynamics: run a pybullet simulation that loads URDF models and steps the physics loop at 240 Hz
create_draw_inertia_box: create a function that draws a debug inertia box wireframe from a body's dynamics info
change_dynamics_mass: change the mass of a pybullet body using changeDynamics with a body UID and link index
get_dynamics_info: get the mass, friction coefficient, and inertia tensor of a pybullet body using getDynamicsInfo
load_urdf_models: load URDF models into a pybullet simulation with specified base position and orientation
